examples.english: You said you wanted to eat, so accordingly let’s go now.
examples.traditional: 你話想食飯，咁就而家去啦。

examples.english: You do not eat breakfast, therefore you will get hungry.
examples.traditional: 你唔食早餐，咁就會肚餓。

examples.english: If you don't want to go, then stay home.
examples.traditional: 你唔想去，咁就留喺屋企啦。
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 gam2 zau6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 laa1
